claims.text: AERD (polyps + asthma + ASA sensitivity): ASA desensitization may help
claims.quote: Aspirin desensitization may benefit patients with AERD, characterized by nasal polyps, asthma, and aspirin sensitivity.
Treatments include endoscopic sinus surgery; topical, inhaled, or oral corticosteroids; aspirin desensitization; leukotriene modifying drugs; and the new class of biologics such as dupilumab.
claims.locator: Aspirin-exacerbated respiratory disease review. Laryngoscope Investig Otolaryngol. 2020 (PMC7314471)
